Experimental alloys with 80 g in weight were prepared from high-purity Co (99.9 wt %), Ti (99.9 wt %), V (99.95 wt %), and Ru (99.9 wt %) in a vacuum arc furnace. The cast ingots were turned over and remelted 5 times to achieve the composition homogeneity.
The cast materials were solutionized at 1100 °C for 48 h and aged at 870 °C for 72 h under an argon atmosphere.
The cast materials were solutionized at 1100 °C for 48 h and aged at 870 °C for 72 h under an argon atmosphere.

To obtain the best mechanical properties and investigate the morphologies of the γ′ phase, the samples were quickly quenched into ice water after the heat treatment. The microstructural morphology was investigated by using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) (Zeiss Merlin Compact), which was operated at 10 kV.
